catalogue.about: A catalogue of the free React Bits components. Facts only: no component source is kept here.

components.name: TechText
components.title: Tech Text
components.description: A wordmark whose letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor.

components.name: TextLoop
components.title: Text Loop
components.description: A seamless text marquee that flows along curved SVG paths.

components.name: MaskedHeading
components.title: Masked Heading
components.description: A headline with a drifting colour mesh or image showing through, revealed word by word.

components.name: ParticleText
components.title: Particle Text
components.description: Text assembles from drifting particles that scatter and reform on demand.

components.name: SplitFlapText
components.title: Split Flap Text
components.description: Mechanical split-flap departure board that clacks through to each new phrase.

components.name: WarpText
components.title: Warp Text
components.description: WebGL warp that bends and refracts the text around the pointer.

components.name: StrokeText
components.title: Stroke Text
components.description: Outlined letterforms draw themselves on, then flood with fill.

components.name: DepthText
components.title: Depth Text
components.description: Layered extruded type with parallax that shifts against the pointer.

components.name: FoldText
components.title: Fold Text
components.description: Lines unfold into place like creased paper opening flat.

components.name: EchoText
components.title: Echo Text
components.description: Ghosted copies trail behind the text and settle into a single word.

components.name: SplitText
components.title: Split Text
components.description: Splits text into characters / words for staggered entrance animation.

components.name: BlurText
components.title: Blur Text
components.description: Text starts blurred then crisply resolves for a soft-focus reveal effect.

components.name: CircularText
components.title: Circular Text
components.description: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.

components.name: TextType
components.title: Text Type
components.description: Typewriter effect with blinking cursor and adjustable typing cadence.

components.name: Shuffle
components.title: Shuffle
components.description: Animated text reveal where characters shuffle before settling.

components.name: ShinyText
components.title: Shiny Text
components.description: A sheen of light that sweeps across text, from soft bands to chrome-like reflections.

components.name: TextPressure
components.title: Text Pressure
components.description: Characters scale / warp interactively based on pointer pressure zone.

components.name: CurvedLoop
components.title: Curved Loop
components.description: Flowing looping text path along a customizable curve with drag interaction.

components.name: FuzzyText
components.title: Fuzzy Text
components.description: Vibrating fuzzy text with controllable hover intensity.

components.name: GradientText
components.title: Gradient Text
components.description: Living gradients inside your text: a sliding sweep, a drifting mesh or a swinging conic fan.

components.name: FallingText
components.title: Falling Text
components.description: Text that breaks apart and tumbles into a pile you can drag, throw and swipe, then flies back into place.

components.name: TextCursor
components.title: Text Cursor
components.description: Text or emoji that trails your cursor as stamped copies, a following chain or a ribbon of letters.

components.name: DecryptedText
components.title: Decrypted Text
components.description: Hacker-style decryption cycling random glyphs until resolving to real text.

components.name: TrueFocus
components.title: True Focus
components.description: Applies dynamic blur / clarity based over a series of words in order.

components.name: ScrollFloat
components.title: Scroll Float
components.description: Text gently floats / parallax shifts on scroll.

components.name: ScrollReveal
components.title: Scroll Reveal
components.description: Text gently unblurs and reveals on scroll.

components.name: ASCIIText
components.title: ASCII Text
components.description: Waving ASCII text that tilts toward the pointer, scrambles on hover and ripples on click.

components.name: ScrambledText
components.title: Scrambled Text
components.description: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.

components.name: RotatingText
components.title: Rotating Text
components.description: Cycles through multiple phrases with 3D rotate / flip transitions.

components.name: GlitchText
components.title: Glitch Text
components.description: RGB split and distortion glitch effect with jitter effects.

components.name: ScrollVelocity
components.title: Scroll Velocity
components.description: Text marquee animatio - speed and distortion scale with user's scroll velocity.

components.name: VariableProximity
components.title: Variable Proximity
components.description: Letter styling changes continuously with pointer distance mapping.

components.name: CountUp
components.title: Count Up
components.description: Animated number counter supporting formatting and decimals.

components.name: CrystalizedBall
components.title: Crystalized Ball
components.description: A glass ball with a crackling electric rim and glowing dust that swirls with the cursor.

components.name: ElectricLogo
components.title: Electric Logo
components.description: Turns any logo into a living lightning outline, with arcs that leap off its edges.

components.name: DitherVeil
components.title: Dither Veil
components.description: A 1-bit dithered photo the cursor burns through to full colour, knitting back cell by cell.

components.name: GlowCursor
components.title: Glow Cursor
components.description: Light that pours from the cursor, drifts softly through the air and cools as it fades.

components.name: ScrollExpand
components.title: Scroll Expand
components.description: A rounded media frame that grows to full bleed as it scrolls through the viewport.

components.name: RippleDistortion
components.title: Ripple Distortion
components.description: Pointer-driven water displacement that warps content and leaves a decaying wake.

components.name: ElasticMesh
components.title: Elastic Mesh
components.description: Turns text or any logo into a puffy inflated shape you can press, poke and stretch like jelly.

components.name: SwarmCursor
components.title: Swarm Cursor
components.description: A liquid swarm of particles that flows after the cursor, curls into eddies and pours around hovered buttons.

components.name: HalftoneReveal
components.title: Halftone Reveal
components.description: A halftone print of an image whose dots swell into the real photo under the cursor.

components.name: PixelSwap
components.title: Pixel Swap
components.description: New content builds in pixel by pixel in a springy wave that starts wherever the cursor enters.

components.name: CursorGrid
components.title: Cursor Grid
components.description: A crisp grid whose cells light up and fade behind the cursor, with grid styles, tiles and click pulses.

components.name: AnimatedContent
components.title: Animated Content
components.description: Wrapper that reveals its content on scroll with slides, blur, 3D tilts, soft wipes and staggered children.

components.name: FadeContent
components.title: Fade Content
components.description: Wrapper that fades content in on scroll, plain or out of focus, from washed-out gray, or through grain, mist and pixel blocks.

components.name: ElectricBorder
components.title: Electric Border
components.description: Wraps any element in crackling strands of current that surge near the cursor and leap off in sparks.

components.name: OrbitImages
components.title: Orbit Images
components.description: SVG Path customizable orbiting images effect

components.name: PixelTransition
components.title: Pixel Transition
components.description: Retro pixel dissolve that covers a card in solid pixels, swaps the content underneath and clears again.

components.name: GlareHover
components.title: Glare Hover
components.description: A glossy light streak that sweeps across any element in the direction the cursor moves.

components.name: LogoLoop
components.title: Logo Loop
components.description: Continuously looping marquee of brand or tech logos with seamless repeat and hover pause.

components.name: TargetCursor
components.title: Target Cursor
components.description: A reticle cursor whose corner brackets snap around targets, matching their shape.

components.name: LaserFlow
components.title: Laser Flow
components.description: A beam of light that splashes onto your content and pours over its corners.

components.name: GhostCursor
components.title: Ghost Cursor
components.description: A ghost of glowing smoke that floats after the cursor and curls away as it rises.

components.name: GradualBlur
components.title: Gradual Blur
components.description: Progressive edge blur for headers, footers, captions and carousels, with an optional fade to color that hides at the ends of a scroll.

components.name: ClickSpark
components.title: Click Spark
components.description: Bursts of sparks at every click, as dashes, comets, dots or stars, that can spill around buttons.

components.name: Magnet
components.title: Magnet
components.description: Elements magnetically ease toward the cursor then settle back with spring physics.

components.name: Strands
components.title: Strands
components.description: Spectral strands that twist inside a frosted glass orb and swell into a smooth bulge where they come together, like the new Siri.

components.name: StickerPeel
components.title: Sticker Peel
components.description: A die-cut sticker you can peel at any edge, drag, throw and swing, in gloss, matte or holographic finishes.

components.name: PixelTrail
components.title: Pixel Trail
components.description: Glossy pixels melt into a fluid goo trail behind the cursor, with color shifts and drips.

components.name: Cubes
components.title: Cubes
components.description: A grid of outlined 3D cubes that turn to face the cursor, spin when swept and ripple on click.

components.name: MetallicPaint
components.title: Metallic Paint
components.description: Liquid chrome that flows over your logo or text, adapted from Paper's Liquid Metal shader.

components.name: Noise
components.title: Noise
components.description: Film grain overlay for photos and pages, from fine 35mm grain to dust, paper and TV static.

components.name: ShapeBlur
components.title: Shape Blur
components.description: A crisp logo or shape that drifts out of focus under the pointer like a camera lens.

components.name: Crosshair
components.title: Crosshair
components.description: Crosshair cursor with live coordinates that locks onto links and buttons and measures them.

components.name: ImageTrail
components.title: Image Trail
components.description: Cursor-based image trail with several built-in variants.

components.name: Ribbons
components.title: Ribbons
components.description: Springy ribbons that trail the cursor, in lens, comet or even shapes with an optional wave.

components.name: SplashCursor
components.title: Splash Cursor
components.description: A fluid simulation that trails the cursor in swirling ink and bursts into a splash on click.

components.name: MetaBalls
components.title: Meta Balls
components.description: Liquid metaballs that merge, stretch and pinch apart, with a cursor blob that pushes through them.

components.name: BlobCursor
components.title: Blob Cursor
components.description: Liquid metal blob cursor that stretches, sloshes and bursts into droplets, in chrome, jelly, pearl or ink.

components.name: StarBorder
components.title: Star Border
components.description: A twinkling star that travels the exact outline of any button, pill or card, trailing light and stardust.

components.name: HoloCard
components.title: Holo Card
components.description: Collectible trading card with a real holographic foil and glitter that sparkles as it tilts.

components.name: CircularCarousel
components.title: Circular Carousel
components.description: A 3D ring of images with bendable cards, momentum drag, snapping and click to focus.

components.name: FlexCarousel
components.title: Flex Carousel
components.description: An infinite image row that flows through invisible liquid glass at its edges.

components.name: InfiniteSpiral
components.title: Infinite Spiral
components.description: An endlessly looping 3D helix of images with adjustable motion, depth and spacing.

components.name: DepthCarousel
components.title: Depth Carousel
components.description: Cards recede into depth on a 3D rail, with drag, keyboard and auto-advance.

components.name: MorphSlider
components.title: Morph Slider
components.description: WebGL slider that melts between images with a displacement transition.

components.name: DriftWall
components.title: Drift Wall
components.description: An endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past, lifting on hover.

components.name: AccordionGallery
components.title: Accordion Gallery
components.description: Panels expand on hover or focus, revealing parallax imagery and captions.

components.name: SpecularButton
components.title: Specular Button
components.description: Glass button whose edge catches the light, with a highlight that glides toward the cursor.

components.name: OptionWheel
components.title: Option Wheel
components.description: Curved option picker that spins with scroll, drag or arrow keys, tilting items away.

components.name: CurvedInput
components.title: Curved Input
components.description: Arc-bent input bar with text, caret and submit button all following the curve.

components.name: LineSidebar
components.title: Line Sidebar
components.description: Static list navigation with a cursor-proximity effect that shifts and highlights nearby items.

components.name: AnimatedList
components.title: Animated List
components.description: A scrolling list whose rows spring into view, with a gliding selection and arrow keys.

components.name: ScrollStack
components.title: Scroll Stack
components.description: Cards pin and stack as you scroll, settling back into a dimmed deck with smooth, jitter-free motion.

components.name: BubbleMenu
components.title: Bubble Menu
components.description: Floating circular expanding menu with staggered item reveal.

components.name: MagicBento
components.title: Magic Bento
components.description: A bento grid of feature cards with live artwork, edge light that follows the cursor and a click wave.

components.name: CircularGallery
components.title: Circular Gallery
components.description: A curved image gallery you can drag, scroll or tab through, with cards that open to the full image.

components.name: ReflectiveCard
components.title: Reflective Card
components.description: A metal ID card that reflects your camera or a looping video and catches the light as it tilts.

components.name: CardNav
components.title: Card Nav
components.description: A navigation bar that springs open into a row of cards, each with its own links.

components.name: Stack
components.title: Stack
components.description: Pile of cards you can drag, flick or click through, with thrown cards tucking underneath.

components.name: FluidGlass
components.title: Fluid Glass
components.description: A 3D glass object that refracts your headline, image or video, follows the cursor and melts between shapes.

components.name: PillNav
components.title: Pill Nav
components.description: A pill navigation bar where a fill rises through each link as its label rolls over, with a sliding active dot.

components.name: TiltedCard
components.title: Tilted Card
components.description: A 3D card that tilts toward the cursor, with glare, a soft shadow, floating layers and a flip side.

components.name: Masonry
components.title: Masonry
components.description: A masonry gallery that springs into place, reflows as it resizes and opens images in a lightbox.

components.name: GlassSurface
components.title: Glass Surface
components.description: Apple-style liquid glass that bends what is behind it, in a rounded panel or any logo shape.

components.name: DomeGallery
components.title: Dome Gallery
components.description: Immersive 3D dome gallery projecting images on a hemispheric surface.

components.name: ChromaGrid
components.title: Chroma Grid
components.description: A grid of grayscale photo cards where a spotlight follows the cursor and brings back color.

components.name: Folder
components.title: Folder
components.description: Folder that drops its flap open or swings open like a book, with pages you can pick.

components.name: StaggeredMenu
components.title: Staggered Menu
components.description: Menu with staggered item animations and smooth transitions on open/close.

components.name: ModelViewer
components.title: Model Viewer
components.description: A product-style 3D model viewer that frames itself and floats over a soft shadow.

components.name: Lanyard
components.title: Lanyard
components.description: Swinging 3D badge on a stretchy woven band that you can drag, throw or click to flip.

components.name: ProfileCard
components.title: Profile Card
components.description: A framed profile card that tilts toward the cursor, with holographic foil shining through a tiled pattern.

components.name: Dock
components.title: Dock
components.description: macOS style dock with smooth magnification, launch bounce, badges and context menus.

components.name: GooeyNav
components.title: Gooey Nav
components.description: A navigation bar whose active pill breaks into goo that flows over to the item you pick.

components.name: PixelCard
components.title: Pixel Card
components.description: A card that fills with twinkling pixels on hover, rippling out from the center or the cursor.

components.name: Carousel
components.title: Carousel
components.description: Swipeable cards for feature tours, stories and galleries, with five transitions and an autoplay timer.

components.name: SpotlightCard
components.title: Spotlight Card
components.description: Card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, catches its edge and reaches nearby cards.

components.name: BorderGlow
components.title: Border Glow
components.description: Glowing mesh-gradient border that follows cursor direction and intensifies near edges.

components.name: FlyingPosters
components.title: Flying Posters
components.description: 3D posters that twist and flip as you scroll or drag through an endless column.

components.name: CardSwap
components.title: Card Swap
components.description: A 3D stack of cards that sends the front card to the back on a timer, or when you fling it.

components.name: GlassIcons
components.title: Glass Icons
components.description: Liquid glass icons that bend the color behind them, for app grids, docks and social links.

components.name: DecayCard
components.title: Decay Card
components.description: An image card that tears and melts as the pointer moves, then pulls itself back together.

components.name: FlowingMenu
components.title: Flowing Menu
components.description: A full-height menu with a liquid band that glides between rows and reveals a scrolling marquee of each item.

components.name: ElasticSlider
components.title: Elastic Slider
components.description: A slider that grows under your cursor and stretches like rubber when pulled past either end, then springs back.

components.name: Counter
components.title: Counter
components.description: An odometer-style number whose digits roll to every new value, with currency, separators and locales.

components.name: InfiniteMenu
components.title: Infinite Menu
components.description: A draggable sphere of image tiles that snaps the nearest one forward and shows its title.

components.name: Stepper
components.title: Stepper
components.description: A multi-step flow with a gliding step indicator, spring transitions and horizontal or vertical layouts.

components.name: BounceCards
components.title: Bounce Cards
components.description: A fan of photo cards that bounce in, then spread apart and straighten the one you hover.

components.name: Shredder
components.title: Shredder
components.description: A list with a paper shredder at the bottom that cuts dragged rows into curling strips.

components.name: PaperCrumple
components.title: Paper Crumple
components.description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while you hold and drag it.

components.name: TearTicket
components.title: Tear Ticket
components.description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand, fibre by fibre, and drops away.

components.name: FlipCard
components.title: Flip Card
components.description: Two-faced card that flips in 3D on a click, drag or flick and settles on a spring.

components.name: BranchedMenu
components.title: Branched Menu
components.description: Collapsible menu that branches each section from a trunk and traces a line to your pick.

components.name: FolderFloat
components.title: Folder Float
components.description: Folder whose notes spring out into a floating cloud when it opens on hover or press.

components.name: RefineFrame
components.title: Refine Frame
components.description: Media frame that steps an image through generation stages without any layout shift.

components.name: ThoughtLine
components.title: Thought Line
components.description: Reasoning trace header with a live clock that folds its steps into one line when done.

components.name: VoicePill
components.title: Voice Pill
components.description: Mic button that swells into a capsule of live equalizer bars and a timer while recording.

components.name: SloshGauge
components.title: Slosh Gauge
components.description: Tank gauge whose liquid chases the value, tilts as it moves and splashes when it fills.

components.name: PromptBar
components.title: Prompt Bar
components.description: Chat composer with @ sources, / commands, a model picker, dictation and attachments.

components.name: SwipeToast
components.title: Swipe Toast
components.description: Toast that swipes down to dismiss and burns a thin fuse for its remaining time.

components.name: SlingButton
components.title: Sling Button
components.description: Send button you pull back like a slingshot and release to fire.

components.name: BellToggle
components.title: Bell Toggle
components.description: Pill toggle where a press rings the bell, crossfades the label and unfurls the pill.

components.name: CallChip
components.title: Call Chip
components.description: Tool-call chip whose fill wipes across as a live timer ticks, ending green or shaking red.

components.name: StatusMark
components.title: Status Mark
components.description: Agent task status glyph that morphs from an idle ring to a progress arc, then a check.

components.name: GlideSelect
components.title: Glide Select
components.description: Select chip whose menu pops from its corner and whose highlight glides between rows.

components.name: SwipeRow
components.title: Swipe Row
components.description: List row that swipes open to reveal actions and deletes on a full swipe.

components.name: JellyRadio
components.title: Jelly Radio
components.description: Radio group of chips where the chosen one swells and barges its neighbours outward.

components.name: CometDial
components.title: Comet Dial
components.description: Tick-ring dial you flick by angle, with a comet that streaks behind the lit head.

components.name: WakeSlider
components.title: Wake Slider
components.description: Thumbless range slider of thin bars where drag speed raises a wake behind the handle.

components.name: CodeSlots
components.title: Code Slots
components.description: One-time code input whose digits spring into their slots, with paste and SMS autofill.

components.name: DodgeField
components.title: Dodge Field
components.description: Wrapper that makes any child dodge the pointer until it relents and glides home.

components.name: LatticeLoader
components.title: Lattice Loader
components.description: Agent status row with a lattice of cells that brighten in a wave beside a live stopwatch.

components.name: ScrubField
components.title: Scrub Field
components.description: Number chip you drag to scrub, with rubber-band limits and click to type.

components.name: FuseButton
components.title: Fuse Button
components.description: Action button whose done state carries an undo on a burning fuse.

components.name: WarmTooltip
components.title: Warm Tooltip
components.description: Tooltip group where the first label waits, then its siblings open instantly while warm.

components.name: SlideCommit
components.title: Slide Commit
components.description: Slide-to-confirm handle that spins while your action runs and unfurls into a done pill.

components.name: RubberSegment
components.title: Rubber Segment
components.description: Segmented control whose rubber thumb stretches across the gap and squashes into place.

components.name: PulseHeart
components.title: Pulse Heart
components.description: Like button that contracts to a dot, flips colour and pulses back as the count ticks over.

components.name: SpringCheck
components.title: Spring Check
components.description: Checkbox row where one spring fills the box, draws the tick and strikes through the label.

components.name: PeekRating
components.title: Peek Rating
components.description: Star rating that lifts a wave of stars up to the pointer, then commits with a pop on click.

components.name: HoldButton
components.title: Hold Button
components.description: Hold-to-confirm button whose liquid fill rises while pressed and snaps back if you let go.

components.name: SquishSwitch
components.title: Squish Switch
components.description: Switch whose thumb stretches with speed and squashes against the end when you flick it.

components.name: HoloMosaic
components.title: Holo Mosaic
components.description: Holographic tiles that split light into sweeping color as it moves, with glitter, a flip-in intro and click waves.

components.name: GradientASCII
components.title: Gradient ASCII
components.description: Soft gradient glows drawn in ASCII characters that scramble under the cursor.

components.name: FluxLines
components.title: Flux Lines
components.description: Glowing flux lines tracing a churning magnetic fluid. The cursor magnet reveals and curls them.

components.name: PatternWaves
components.title: Pattern Waves
components.description: A lit halftone surface of dots, lines or glyphs that moves like draped silk.

components.name: MicroSlats
components.title: Micro Slats
components.description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests.

components.name: ShapeWaves
components.title: Shape Waves
components.description: A field of triangles, circles and squares that brighten and grow along rolling waves.

components.name: AeroShards
components.title: Aero Shards
components.description: Silk ribbons of thick glass shards streaming on layered depths among survey markers, catching light along their edges.

components.name: GhostFibers
components.title: Ghost Fibers
components.description: Layered ribbons of fine glowing fibers that twist, fold and drift through soft depth of field.

components.name: CRTWarp
components.title: CRT Warp
components.description: A blocky plasma glowing on a curved CRT, with real scanlines, a phosphor mask, afterglow and a power-on intro.

components.name: MoltenMetal
components.title: Molten Metal
components.description: Swirling caustic filaments with white-hot cores that heat up under the cursor and flare on click.

components.name: GradientWaves
components.title: Gradient Waves
components.description: Lit satin waves rolling in from a hazy horizon, with a light that follows the cursor and swells on click.

components.name: WebThreads
components.title: Web Threads
components.description: Glowing threads woven through luminous pinch points that light up under the cursor and carry light on click.

components.name: Topography
components.title: Topography
components.description: A 3D landscape drawn in glowing contour lines that rises under the cursor, with light pulses on click.

components.name: LightTunnel
components.title: Light Tunnel
components.description: A swirling fibre-optic tunnel where comets of light race into depth, steered by the cursor.

components.name: SlicedWaves
components.title: Sliced Waves
components.description: Waves of colored light sliced into glowing bars, seen in depth with a focus that follows the cursor.

components.name: AcidSquares
components.title: Acid Squares
components.description: A rolling field of glossy squares that ripples under two drifting colored lights.

components.name: Scanner
components.title: Scanner
components.description: Glowing interference lines swept by a scan beam, with a CRT finish, cursor lensing and click pings.

components.name: Ferrofluid
components.title: Ferrofluid
components.description: A glossy sea of magnetic fluid where swells of spikes roll in and the cursor raises a crown.

components.name: Lightfall
components.title: Lightfall
components.description: Streaks of light falling down a curved tunnel, bending around the cursor and stretching into warp trails on hold.

components.name: LiquidEther
components.title: Liquid Ether
components.description: A glowing liquid that swirls under the cursor, colored by how fast it flows.

components.name: Prism
components.title: Prism
components.description: Rotating prism of glowing spectral light with configurable shape, colors and motion.

components.name: DarkVeil
components.title: Dark Veil
components.description: A silky veil of light that drifts in the dark and bends around the cursor.

components.name: LightPillar
components.title: Light Pillar
components.description: A swirling pillar of light that ignites on load, leans toward the cursor and surges on click.

components.name: Antigravity
components.title: Antigravity
components.description: A field of particles that lifts into a glowing ring around the cursor and bursts outward on click.

components.name: Silk
components.title: Silk
components.description: Flowing satin folds with glossy highlights that turn toward the cursor and ripple on click.

components.name: FloatingLines
components.title: Floating Lines
components.description: Ribbons of fine glowing lines that drift in waves, part around the cursor and curl when clicked.

components.name: SideRays
components.title: Side Rays
components.description: Shafts of light that fan in from a corner or side, shimmer slowly and lean toward the cursor.

components.name: LightRays
components.title: Light Rays
components.description: Volumetric light rays from any edge, with source glow and haze. The cursor steers the beam and casts a shadow.

components.name: PixelBlast
components.title: Pixel Blast
components.description: Dithered pixel clouds that drift, shimmer and light up under the cursor, with ripples, shapes and a perspective floor.

components.name: ColorBends
components.title: Color Bends
components.description: Vibrant color bends with smooth flowing animation.

components.name: LineWaves
components.title: Line Waves
components.description: Fine lines that flow in silky waves while a band of light drifts through them.

components.name: Radar
components.title: Radar
components.description: A radar scope whose sweep leaves a phosphor afterglow and picks up moving contacts.

components.name: SoftAurora
components.title: Soft Aurora
components.description: Soft aurora borealis shader with 3D Perlin noise and cosine gradient palettes.

components.name: MagicRings
components.title: Magic Rings
components.description: Glowing rings that pulse outward in a wave, swell toward the cursor and flare on click.

components.name: Aurora
components.title: Aurora
components.description: A soft, calm aurora that flows across the top of the page and drifts toward the cursor.

components.name: Plasma
components.title: Plasma
components.description: Folds of satin light twisting slowly through the dark, turning to follow the cursor.

components.name: PlasmaWave
components.title: Plasma Wave
components.description: Two ribbons of plasma curling through each other, with soft glow and white-hot cores.

components.name: Particles
components.title: Particles
components.description: A drifting 3D field of particles with glow, twinkle, constellation lines and cursor interaction.

components.name: GradientBlinds
components.title: Gradient Blinds
components.description: Satin gradient blinds lit by a spotlight that follows the cursor, swaying and turning toward the light.

components.name: Grainient
components.title: Grainient
components.description: Flowing grainy gradients you can stir with the cursor.

components.name: GridScan
components.title: Grid Scan
components.description: A 3D grid room swept by a scanning light that follows your view.

components.name: Beams
components.title: Beams
components.description: Glossy ribbons that ripple in the dark and catch the light, which follows your cursor.

components.name: PixelSnow
components.title: Pixel Snow
components.description: Pixel-art snowflakes drifting down in layers of depth, brushed aside by the cursor.

components.name: Lightning
components.title: Lightning
components.description: Crackling, branching lightning that bends toward the cursor and strikes wherever you click.

components.name: PrismaticBurst
components.title: Prismatic Burst
components.description: A burst of prismatic light rays that leans toward the cursor and sends a wave of light outward on click.

components.name: Galaxy
components.title: Galaxy
components.description: Endless flight through a twinkling starfield with warp jumps, cursor repulsion and star palettes.

components.name: Dither
components.title: Dither
components.description: Retro dithered waves with Bayer, halftone, line and noise patterns, palettes and cursor trails.

components.name: FaultyTerminal
components.title: Faulty Terminal
components.description: A flickering CRT terminal of glowing glyphs, with phosphor trails under the cursor and glitches on click.

components.name: RippleGrid
components.title: Ripple Grid
components.description: A crisp grid that ripples like water, bending and lighting up as waves pass through it.

components.name: DotField
components.title: Dot Field
components.description: A gradient dot field seen through a lens that follows the cursor, magnifying, pinching or swirling the dots.

components.name: DotGrid
components.title: Dot Grid
components.description: A springy dot grid that the cursor flicks and drags through like jelly, with click shockwaves.

components.name: Threads
components.title: Threads
components.description: Flowing threads that fray apart and part around the cursor, from fine silk to contour lines.

components.name: Hyperspeed
components.title: Hyperspeed
components.description: Night highway of glowing light trails on a winding road that warps into hyperspace while you hold.

components.name: Iridescence
components.title: Iridescence
components.description: Liquid iridescent surface with shifting folds that you can stir with the cursor.

components.name: Waves
components.title: Waves
components.description: Dense flowing lines that sway like silk, bend around the cursor and spring back into place.

components.name: MagnetLines
components.title: Magnet Lines
components.description: A field of magnetic lines that swing toward the cursor, ripple outward and spin with every click.

components.name: GridDistortion
components.title: Grid Distortion
components.description: Image background that breaks into a grid of blocks under the cursor and settles back into place.

components.name: Ballpit
components.title: Ballpit
components.description: A soft-lit pit of physics balls you can shove with the cursor, grab, throw and blast apart.

components.name: Orb
components.title: Orb
components.description: A glowing ring of swirling color that breathes, trails an orbiting light and reaches toward the cursor.

components.name: LetterGlitch
components.title: Letter Glitch
components.description: A calm field of letters that flicker, scramble and glitch in color, stirred by the cursor and torn by clicks.

components.name: GridMotion
components.title: Grid Motion
components.description: A tilted wall of drifting tiles that slides with the pointer and lights up where it rests.

components.name: ShapeGrid
components.title: Shape Grid
components.description: A drifting grid of shapes that lights up under the cursor, with perspective tilt and rainbow trails.

components.name: LiquidChrome
components.title: Liquid Chrome
components.description: Soft ribbons of liquid chrome that swirl through a dark pool, ripple under the cursor and catch the light as it moves.

components.name: Balatro
components.title: Balatro
components.description: The swirling Balatro paint shader, with crisp pixels, a cursor that stirs the paint and click whirlpools.
